# CloudBoost

CloudBoost is a native macOS menu bar app and gaming session optimizer for cloud gaming, remote play, and native Mac games.

Primary URL: https://victorbrandaao.github.io/CloudBoost/
GitHub releases: https://github.com/victorbrandaao/CloudBoost/releases/latest
Support: https://discord.gg/kU5trxtRb

## What It Does

CloudBoost helps users diagnose and reduce local macOS session issues that can affect gaming:

- latency spikes
- jitter
- packet loss
- background traffic
- AWDL, AirDrop, Handoff, and Wi-Fi interruptions
- DNS state
- Low Power Mode
- thermal pressure
- process priority
- local system pressure

## Supported Use Cases

- GeForce NOW on Mac
- Xbox Cloud Gaming on Mac
- Boosteroid on Mac
- Moonlight on Mac
- PS Remote Play on Mac
- Steam Link on Mac
- native Mac gaming
- Dota 2 on Mac
- League of Legends on Mac
- CS2 cloud or remote play sessions
- Steam, Epic Games, and Battle.net sessions

## Important Limits

CloudBoost does not modify games, inject code, bypass anti-cheat, install kernel extensions, or promise magic FPS gains. It focuses on the local macOS session around the game.

## Plans

Free includes manual sessions, all supported profiles, Balanced preset, basic signal checks, Stream Advisor, and rollback protection.
PRO adds automation, HUD, Session Lab, Stream Signal, PRO Widgets, Heat Guard, Keep Alive, Session Proof, Kernel Watch, background throttle, priority Discord support, early builds, and deeper diagnostics.
